Members

_SPIKE_HALF_TURN

Half-turn divisor mapping ray index → angle.

spikeRay

Paints one spike ray — a radial gradient squeezed along its length so the streak keeps a gaussian cross-section and melts at both ends.

  • @param ctx 2d context.
  • @param mid Canvas center in px.
  • @param ang Ray angle in radians.
  • @param len Ray half-length in px.
  • @param thin Ray half-width as a fraction of len.
  • @param inner Inner css color (hot core).
  • @param outer Outer css color (alpha 0 tail).

spikesFor

Generates a seeded diffraction-spike sprite — six primary rays (the hexagonal cross of a segmented mirror) plus a fainter, shorter second cross rotated a quarter-turn offset so the burst reads optical, not drawn. A tight center knot anchors the burst on the photosphere.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Star def (color = spike tint, id = seed).
  • @returns A CanvasTexture for the spike sprite map, or undefined.
